## Diagnosis

In `crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs`, `wrap_bare_frontmatter` rewrites bare front matter into fenced (`---`) form so the downstream pulldown-cmark MetadataBlock parser can pick it up. Both branches did:

```rust
let cleaned_header: String = header
    .lines()
    .filter(|l| !l.starts_with(' '))   // <-- drops indented lines
    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
    .join("\n");
```

This stripped any indented continuation line — i.e. exactly the lines that carry YAML list items and nested mappings. So a bare document containing:

```
title: Foo
depends:
  - foo
```

was wrapped as:

```
---
title: Foo
depends:
---
```

producing an empty `depends:` value. `metadata_matches` in `find.rs` then saw `Null` for the key and returned `false`, so `iwe find --meta depends=foo` matched nothing. Fenced documents skipped this code path entirely (early `starts_with("---")` return), which is why they continued to work.

## Fix

`crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs`: removed the line-filtering step. The header window already terminates at the first blank line, so every line in it is part of the YAML document and must be passed through verbatim.
